text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 61 par ‘A Kind Boy’ padho. Phir jawab do.
text.en: Read ‘A Kind Boy’ on page 61 of your book. Then answer.

steps.modelAnswer: False. The mother called him for breakfast.

modelMeaning.hinglish: Woh apna homework kar raha tha.

steps.modelAnswer: His mother called him to have his breakfast.

options: Please give me something to eat. I have not eaten for two days.
steps.answer: Please give me something to eat. I have not eaten for two days.

steps.question: Why did the boy give his breakfast to the beggar?

questionMeaning.hi: लड़के ने अपना नाश्ता भिखारी को क्यों दिया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Ladke ne apna naashta bhikhaari ko kyon diya?

options: The beggar was very poor and hungry.
He did not like the food.
steps.answer: The beggar was very poor and hungry.
steps.modelAnswer: The boy gave his breakfast to the beggar because the beggar was very poor and hungry. The boy felt sorry for him.

modelMeaning.hi: लड़के ने नाश्ता दिया क्योंकि भिखारी बहुत ग़रीब और भूखा था। लड़के को उस पर दया आई।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Ladke ne naashta diya kyonki bhikhaari bahut gareeb aur bhookha tha. Ladke ko us par daya aayi.

steps.question: What did his mother find on the bookshelf?

questionMeaning.hi: माँ को किताबों की अलमारी में क्या मिला?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Maa ko kitaabon ki almaari mein kya mila?

options: her son's breakfasts packed in a corner, with red ants around
steps.answer: her son's breakfasts packed in a corner, with red ants around
steps.modelAnswer: His mother found her son's breakfasts packed in a corner of the bookshelf, with red ants all around.

modelMeaning.hi: माँ को अलमारी के कोने में बेटे के नाश्ते रखे मिले, और चारों ओर लाल चींटियाँ थीं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Maa ko almaari ke kone mein bete ke naashte rakhe mile, aur chaaron or laal cheentiyaan thin.

steps.question: Why did the boy keep his breakfast on the bookshelf?

questionMeaning.hi: लड़के ने नाश्ता अलमारी में क्यों रखा?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Ladke ne naashta almaari mein kyon rakha?

options: He was waiting for the beggar to take his share.
steps.answer: He was waiting for the beggar to take his share.
steps.modelAnswer: The boy kept his breakfast on the bookshelf because he was waiting for the beggar to come and take his share.

modelMeaning.hi: लड़के ने नाश्ता अलमारी में रखा क्योंकि वह भिखारी के आकर अपना हिस्सा लेने का इंतज़ार कर रहा था।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Ladke ne naashta almaari mein rakha kyonki woh bhikhaari ke aakar apna hissa lene ka intezaar kar raha tha.
